name: incident.io
summary: incident.io has a free Basic plan with one on-call schedule and one status page. Team costs $15 per user a month on annual billing or $19 monthly, Pro costs $25, and on-call is a separate add-on at $10 on Team or $20 on Pro.

facts.text: Alert routes can send an alert to escalation paths, to users, or to both, and an expression can pick the path from the alert's team or service.
Multiple postmortem documents and a custom post-incident flow start on the Pro plan.
A standalone on-call product costs $20 per user a month, and the pricing page does not say whether that is billed monthly or annually.
The page states SOC 2 Type I and II and GDPR compliance, and does not mention ISO 27001 or HIPAA.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Single-team on-call, 1 schedule, 1 workflow, 2 integrations, 1 public status page

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Billed annually; $19 on monthly billing. On-call adds $10 per user a month

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: The page does not state the billing period. On-call adds $20 per user a month. Includes SAML

plans.name: On-call only
plans.notes: Standalone on-call product; billing period not stated

hiddenCosts: On-call is an add-on on Team and Pro, so a Pro responder with on-call costs $45 per user a month before discounts.
The pricing page does not state the billing period for Pro.
